messages:
Aisha: Quick heads-up — Prospect (NorthStar Analytics) sent an RFI specifically about embeddings pricing, POC ops, and KMS/HSM requirements. I dropped a draft capability matrix in the files section (cap_matrix_v2.xlsx). Need to clarify a few items before we return.
Ravi: Thanks — can you paste the exact asks? short on time today.
Aisha: They want: 1) per-embedding price (including volume breaks), 2) latency SLO for 512-d vectors at 50 qps, 3) whether we support customer-managed KMS + optional HSM for private, 4) if we provide a sandbox POC with limited data retention. Also asked for a short-run benchmark attachments (logs) if possible.
Mei: I can handle pricing and POC ops. For pricing: our public hosted is tiered — for their expected volume (~5M embeddings/mo) we recommend the dedicated commit. Quick draft to insert into the capability matrix:
```
Hosted: $0.00040/embedding (0-1M)
Hosted: $0.00030/embedding (1M-10M)
Dedicated (commit): $0.00018/embedding (5M commit example)
Private (VPC/on-prem): contact AE — includes infra + infra support
```
Mei: Note these are token/embedding-equivalent units — clarify with finance for exact contract math.
Ravi: On latency: our verified profile for the open-embed-512 model is p50 ~ 18ms, p95 ~ 45ms at 50 qps on dedicated A100 pool with batching disabled. For hosted multitenant, expect p95 ~ 120-200ms depending on burst. I can paste the perf CSV into the thread.
Mei: POC ops: we can run a 2-week sandbox on a dedicated pool (limited to their dataset), retention policy 30 days by default but can set to 7 days for POC. We support prefix caching and we can enable KV cache prewarm to reduce cold-starts.
Jon: About KMS/HSM — we support customer-managed KMS in Private and Dedicated via BYOK. HSM-backed keys (FIPS/EKM) are available for Private deployments only; need legal + infra signoff for any HSM proofing. security-bot: [automated] See docs: https://intra.redwood/security/kms-hsm for compliance notes.
Aisha: Good — can you confirm whether HSM + Private covers their regulatory ask (they mentioned FINRA-like controls)? If not, we flag as "requires on-prem with HSM".
Ravi: I need to update the capability column: "Embeddings throughput" + "Latency at 50 qps (512-d)" + "KMS/HSM support" + "POC retention options". I'll edit cap_matrix_v2.xlsx and upload v3.
Mei: Also add a short note under "Limitations": multi-region replication for Private is not GA — only single-region for the on-prem package. Important for their DR question.
Aisha: Attachment plan: 1) capability_matrix_v3.xlsx (Ravi) 2) perf_csv_50qps.csv (Ravi) 3) POC-runbook.pdf (Mei) 4) security_extract.pdf (sec-bot / legal) — aim to assemble by Thu EOD.
Jon: For the written RFI responses, keep bullets short. Example answer for KMS: "Yes — customer-managed keys supported for Dedicated and Private; HSM-backed keys supported in Private on customer-provided FIPS HSM or vetted KMS partners. See security_extract.pdf for enrollment steps." Use that language.
Aisha: Who will own the final send? I can if we have all attachments by Thu morning.
Ravi: I’ll upload perf CSV + updated matrix by 16:00 PT Wed. Mei will own POC runbook by Wed EOD. security-bot: [automated] SOC2 report and encryption summary added to security_extract.pdf (uploaded).
Mei: Quick question on pricing wording — do we include "sample commit pricing" or only ranges? Legal prefers sample commit numbers with a note: "subject to contract".
Aisha: Include sample commit + note. Also include a line that we can offer a short 30-day trial credit to validate embed quality and latency; call it out under POC commercial terms.
Ravi: One more technical ask from prospect: can we support embedding-only endpoints with a fixed max vector dimension? We do — we have model selection and quantization profiles; add "embedding-dim restrictions" row.
Aisha: Perfect. Last: please add a tiny FAQ entry: "How do you handle PII in embeddings?" — short answer: "By default we do not retain raw inputs beyond configured retention; Private deployments allow customer-side preprocessing and on-prem storage." Mei / Ravi to draft.
Mei: Draft for PII FAQ: "Redwood does not store user inputs beyond configured retention for hosted; Dedicated and Private allow customer-managed data lifecycle; for regulated workloads we recommend Private with on-prem KMS/HSM." Will paste into matrix.
Aisha: Great — target send: Thu 17:00 PT. If anything slips, bump this thread. :thumbsup:
Ravi: Uploaded cap_matrix_v3.xlsx (file) + perf_csv_50qps.csv (file). Link: https://files.redwood/cap_matrix_v3.xlsx
Mei: Uploaded POC_runbook_draft.pdf (file). Pls review.
security-bot: [automated] security_extract.pdf uploaded and shared with Aisha, Ravi, Mei, Jon.
Aisha: Thanks everyone. I'll do a final pass Thu AM and send the RFI response pack to the prospect. "Action items: Ravi — verify latency numbers in CSV; Mei — finalize runbook + PII FAQ; Jon — quick legal language check for HSM sentence."
